issues.description: The render-harness JucePlugin_ManufacturerCode stub is 0x4f756172 ('Ouar'), which matches neither the release manufacturer code OuAu nor the dev code OuDv. This is a hand-written stub for compiling PluginProcessor.cpp in the headless console app, which never registers an AU/VST3 component, so the value has zero functional impact and does not block the gate. Note the sibling JucePlugin_PluginCode stub IS correct (0x4f536942 = 'OSiB').
issues.fixSuggestion: For consistency with the project standard, update the JucePlugin_ManufacturerCode macro in the harness CMake to the OuAu/OuDv code (0x4f754175 / 0x4f754476) so the test stub mirrors the real plugin; purely cosmetic, defer freely as it affects no built artifact.
